elsewhere.note: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.
Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom…
“Therefore I will scatter them, as the stubble that passes away, by the wind of the wilderness.
Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in…
The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them, and devour them. There will not…
For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.
